data.name: Leeladhar
data.gender_notes: Leeladhar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Leeladhar is a name of divine origin, derived from the Sanskrit words 'leela' (play, sport) and 'dhar' (to uphold). The name symbolizes the divine play or sport of the gods, reflecting the concept of the universe as an expression of divine will. It is a powerful and auspicious name for a boy in Hindu tradition. The name Leeladhar carries the meaning “Divine play or sport” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Leeladhar usually hope their child will grow to embody divine play or sport and live with faith, good character and purpose.
